Note what this entry deliberately does NOT say: `private: true`. Privacy here
comes from the ledger it lives in — `[ledger].tier = "person"` — because

itself claims. Keeping the marker off the entry is what leaves the leak test a
single-variable red side: declare the same parent `repo` instead, and the title
above is printed by the same renderer, on the same run, from the same bytes.

SENTINEL-PRIVATE-TEXT: no second side project is started here.

Every other line of this file is written to share no vocabulary with the plan
the leak test runs, so the marked sentence is the only unit here that plan can
match. Delete it and the verdict goes compliant — which is what proves the

Attention is the scarce resource, and it does not divide.
